notes.title: UsoNatsu 1 Year Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
November 3rd, 2024 marks one year since Usonatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ came out on Steam! Since then, the game has garnered a 94% Very Positive review score on Steam. We have all the fans to thank for the positive response!

In celebration, we are putting Usonatsu on sale with a 30% discount for this week's Week Long Discount promotion. This is a perfect opportunity for fans who haven't had a chance to experience this dramatic visual novel to give it a go.

On top of that, the UsoNatsu Voice Drama is also on sale with a 20% discount. Please note that it is recommended to finish the original game before listening to the voice drama to avoid spoilers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973220/UsoNatsu_The_Summer_Romance_Bloomed_From_A_Lie_Voice_Drama/

As always, thank you to everyone for your support in making this game a success!

notes.title: Campfire Crowdfunding Campaign Underway For New Voice Drama Project
notes.notes:
First announced alongside the release of the first chapter of the spinoff manga, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1575980/announcements/detail/6501595246337833868]UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ -squall-[/url], UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ - Parallel Palette - is the second voice drama project by developer, [url=https://lycoris-works.com/]LYCORIS[/url]. This what-if story focuses on the relationship between Tachibana Kaoru (voiced by Koichi Makoto) and the teacher she fell in love with, Shimotsuki Mirei (voiced by Matsui Eriko).

For fans that may not have played UsoNatsu yet and are worried about spoilers, Parallel Palette can be enjoyed by listening to the mini voice drama "Falling, In Love" which is available to listen for free on Youtube.

[b]Youtube Link[/b] (Turn on closed captioning for English subtitles)

notes.title: Today is Inohara Riku's Birthday!
notes.notes:
It's September 13th and that means it's Inohara Riku's birthday!

In celebration, the developer has shared an adorable illustration by character designer, Shio Koji.
[url=https://twitter.com/LYCORIS_info/status/1834527191524417858]https://twitter.com/LYCORIS_info/status/1834527191524417858[/url]

Riku is honest yet kind. While she gets easily embarrassed, Riku is the [i]tsukkomi[/i] (straight woman) who cares greatly for her friends. Though she hides the fact that she is a hard worker, this lover of donuts occasionally shows everyone a smile that is as bright as the sun.

Enjoy a donut or two in celebration of Riku's special day!

notes.title: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Manga to Start Serialization
notes.notes:
The developer, LYCORIS, has confirmed that serialization of the manga spin-off for UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ has begun. First announced back in July 2024, the spin-off manga, entitled [b]UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ -squall-[/b], is being serialized starting in the October 2024 issue of Comic Yurihime magazine which came out on August 16, 2024 in Japan.

The story in the comic serves as a prequel to the game itself and focuses on the early relationship between Tachibana Kaoru and her teacher, Shimotsuki Mirei. The artist behind the manga is none other than Rococo, a popular yuri manga artist who also worked on the manga series, [i]Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri[/i].

Currently, there is no information on an upcoming English release.

In celebration of the start of the comic, UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ as well as the soundtrack and the recently released voice drama will be on sale this week!

For more information:
LYCORIS Official Website - [url=https://lycoris-works.com/]https://lycoris-works.com/[/url]
Rococo Twitter - [url=https://x.com/rococomm123]https://twitter.com/rococomm123[/url]

notes.title: UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama Update
notes.notes:
There was an issue where users were not able to access the Simplified Chinese video files after downloading the UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama. This issue has been addressed and those files should now be downloadable if the user's language setting is set to Simplified Chinese.

If you wish to download those video files when not using Simplified Chinese language settings, right click on the UsoNatsu ~The Summer Romance Bloomed From A Lie~ Voice Drama in your Steam Library and select Properties. The general tab will have an option to change languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44431254/b787de74d0d7423cd390d06861dc7b9b587f411a.jpg[/img]

An update will be coming with liner notes including a translation for the cast commentary track. Thank you for your understanding and please enjoy this continuation to the UsoNatsu story!
